name: Weekly allowance
description: Pays a fixed pocket-money amount in BSV to one person (address or paymail) you set: $5 at a time, at most $5 a day and $20 in total, so roughly a month of weekly payments. Replace the placeholder in sendTo before loading. Sending is final.
goals: Once a week, send $5 of BSV to the allowance address. Never more than once a day, never to anyone else.

spec.trades: BSV only, sent to one person you set
spec.needs: The recipient in sendTo before loading
